<thought>The 13C NMR shows three downfield peaks: 167 ppm (likely a carbonyl) and two peaks at 143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm, which fall in the aromatic region. Only two distinct aromatic carbon signals suggest a symmetric aromatic ring, such as a para‑disubstituted benzene, where the six aromatic carbons appear as two equivalent sets. Therefore the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
